title: Explosion near a school in eastern Afghanistan kills at least 10 people
caption:
An explosion near a middle school in Asadabad, the capital of Afghanistan's Kunar province, killed at least 10 people on Saturday, including students, and injured about 110, the Taliban's interior ministry says. Early findings point to explosives stored nearby by mining companies. Officials say the figures are preliminary and an investigation is under way.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
